effect_description_eng:
＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, if you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [Leviathan] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
